verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ॥
verses.translit_en: soraThaa: a(n)mirat dhirasaT nivaas a(n)mirat bachan anahadh sabadh ||

en.bdb: Sorath: In the divine glimpse of Guru Amar Das dwells the elixir of life. (On whomsoever he casts his look, he makes him immortal). His elixir-like words are like unstruck music.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur amar pragaas mil a(n)mirat a(n)mirat bhe ||

en.bdb: Resplendent True Guru Amar Das Ji became elixir-like after meeting Guru Angad Dev Ji. He now makes others calm and mortal.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhoharaa: a(n)mirat bachan anahadh sabadh a(n)mirat dhirasaT nivaas ||

en.bdb: Dohra: Meditating on unstruck melodious Divine Word, the sight and utterances of Guru Amar Das Ji, started showering elixir of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
verses.translit_en: mil a(n)mirat a(n)mirat bhe satigur amar pragaas ||

en.bdb: Meeting Guru Angad Dev Ji, elixir-like cool, tranquil and granter of emancipation, Satgur Amar Das too became the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛੰਦ: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: chha(n)dh: satigur amar pragaas taas charanaamirat paavai ||

en.bdb: Channt: Satgur Amar Das Ji who is light refulgent, whosoever partakes nectar-like wash of his feet,

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaam naam nihakaam param padh sahaj samaavai ||

en.bdb: Becomes free from all desires is absorbed in high state of spirituality and equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sa(n)dh suga(n)dh saadh sa(n)gat nij aasan ||

en.bdb: By the fragrance of Naam Simran of Guru Amar Das Ji, the Guru's obedient seeker finds stability in the company of holy men and Lord's devotees

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਨ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat dhirasaT nivaas a(n)mirat mukh bachan pragaasan ||4||

en.bdb: In the elixir-like vision of Guru Amar Das lies the nectar of life and his words provide elixir-like luminance of Naam of the Lord. (4)
